title: fix(metadata-protocol): a migrate-stored pass records the user who ran it, or nobody — never a label
body:
Fixes #23068
Clause-②: no

The stored-metadata migration pass and its three doors passed a label as `PutOptions.actor`. The contract (#4556) allows a user id or `null`, never a label. With this change, each producer passes the acting user's id when there is one and nothing otherwise, so the write records `null`. The pass still names itself on `source: 'migrate-stored'`, as before. This follows the triage direction in comment 6128747332: one PR covering the four producers and the describe, and no repository-side filter.

## Measured first, on `origin/main` `275ad4229a`

- **Reproduced.** I built `metadata-core` and `metadata-protocol` from `275ad4229a` and ran a scratch probe of `migrateStoredMetadata({ apply: true })` over one legacy `object` row in a stub engine. The probe read back what the repository wrote:
  - no actor: `recorded_by: ["migrate-stored"]`, `updated_by: ["migrate-stored"]`;
  - the REST door's value: `recorded_by: ["admin (POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-stored)"]`, and the same string in `updated_by`;
  - the CLI's value: `recorded_by: ["os migrate meta --stored"]`, and the same string in `updated_by`.
  `source` was `migrate-stored` in every run.
- **The new pins on the unfixed source** (commit `c1269849e7`, before the fix):
  - protocol: `expected [ 'migrate-stored', 'migrate-stored' ] to deeply equal [ null, null ]`;
  - REST: `expected 'admin (POST /meta/_migrate-stored)' to be 'admin'`, and an `isSystem` caller still sent an `actor`;
  - runtime: `expected 'admin (POST /metadata/_migrate-stored)' to be 'admin'`, and an `isSystem` caller still sent an `actor`;
  - CLI: both `--apply` and the preview sent an `actor`.
  The pin that passes a user id through the protocol was green before the fix, which is expected: the protocol already forwarded a caller's id unchanged.

## What identity each producer has

| producer | identity in hand | now passes |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.migrateStoredMetadata` | the caller's `request.actor` | `request.actor` when given. With none, nothing is forwarded, and `saveMetaItem`'s #4556 default records `null` (it used to default to `'migrate-stored'`) |
| REST `POST …/meta/_migrate-stored` | the authenticated execution context it already resolves for its `manage_metadata` gate | `resolveMetaWriteActor(environmentId, req)`, the same producer every other `/meta` write door uses (memoized per request). It returns the user id or `undefined` |
| runtime dispatcher `POST /metadata/_migrate-stored` | `executionContext.userId` | the user id when it is a non-empty string, otherwise nothing |
| `os migrate meta --stored` | none: it boots its own stack against the database directly, with no session | no actor, so the rows record `null` |

No new log line was added. With the label gone, the door is still identifiable: `source: 'migrate-stored'` marks the pass on every history row, and `recorded_by` is a user id (a REST or runtime caller) or `null` (the CLI, or an `isSystem` caller). The two HTTP doors are the same operation, so naming which transport ran it would tell an operator nothing more.

## Change

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: in `migrateStoredMetadata`, `actor: request.actor ?? 'migrate-stored'` becomes a spread that forwards `actor` only when one is given. The `actor` field's doc now states the rule, and the header's `source` bullet says that `source` is the only place the pass names itself.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: the `_migrate-stored` handler takes its actor from `resolveMetaWriteActor` and no longer builds the inline label. That helper's header list of the doors it serves now includes this route.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`: the `_migrate-stored` branch passes the user id or nothing.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`: `runStored` passes no `actor`.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/types.ts`: `MetadataItemSchema.authoredBy`'s describe changes from `user id, "cli", "ai:claude", …` to the `PutOptions.actor` rule: the acting user id, or `null` for a system-initiated write, never a label such as `"system"` or `"cli"`. **Readers:** `git grep` for an `authoredBy` comparison, `startsWith`, `includes` or `match`, and for an `'ai:'` prefix test, across `packages/` finds no hits. No reader parses `authoredBy` for those labels. The schema accepts the same values as before.
- `.changeset/23068-migrate-actor.md`: `patch` for all five packages, written for an operator.

## Pins

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.stored-migration.test.ts`, new block `#23068`, using the file's existing stub engine (no new double and no ledger change):
  - a pass run by `usr_operator` records `['usr_operator']` in `recorded_by` and in the row's `updated_by`;
  - a pass with no user records `[null, null]` in both columns over two rewritten rows, with `source` still `migrate-stored`.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-migrate-stored.test.ts`: the attribution pin goes from `toContain('admin')`, which the label also satisfied, to `toBe('admin')`. A new pin checks that an `isSystem` caller sends no `actor`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-migrate-stored.test.ts`: the same two pins.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.stored-actor.test.ts` (new, `unit` tier): runs the real `MigrateMeta` with only the boot, the occupancy probe and the plugin list replaced, and checks that neither `--apply` nor the preview hands `migrateStoredMetadata` an `actor`.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.stored-flow-resolution.integration.test.ts`: its copy of "the command's exact call" drops the `actor` the command no longer sends. Its Studio-save probe now passes a user-id-shaped actor in place of the label `studio-roundtrip-probe`.

## Ablation

The fix was committed first. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, inside a script with its own `trap` that restores both files from `HEAD`. All four pin files resolve their subject from source (relative imports, or a mocked protocol), so no rebuild was involved.

- **Leg A: the protocol default restored to `request.actor ?? 'migrate-stored'`.** The anchor hit once and fell 1 to 0, and the blob changed from `799733c6b23f` to `9290dc96e3ad`. Result: the protocol `#23068` block had 1 failed and 1 passed (`expected [ 'migrate-stored', 'migrate-stored' ] to deeply equal [ null, null ]`; the user-id pin stayed green). REST 16/16, runtime 14/14 and CLI 2/2 stayed green.
- **Leg B: the REST door restored to the route-name label.** The anchor hit once and fell 1 to 0, and the blob changed from `712ca3eb781b` to `79e1b90a562a`. Result: REST had 2 failed and 14 passed. The protocol `#23068` pins (2/2), runtime 14/14 and CLI 2/2 stayed green.
- **Restore:** both blobs are equal to `HEAD` (`799733c6b23f`, `712ca3eb781b`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## Verification

`origin/main` `038d4c9588` (#23070) was merged once, at `df2f5e39df`. The closure `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli...` was rebuilt after the merge (59/59 tasks).

- At `df2f5e39df`:
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `pnpm test`: 228 files passed and 3 skipped; 28205 tests passed. Exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-core` `pnpm test`: 18 files, 685 tests. Exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/rest` `pnpm test` (`--project local`): 274 files, 5752 tests passed. Exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/runtime` `pnpm test` (`--project local`): 359 files, 5154 tests passed. Exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/cli` `--project unit`: 284 files, 4272 tests. Exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/cli` `--project integration` on the one integration file this PR edits: 3/3. Exit 0. The rest of the integration tier is left to CI.
  - `typecheck` for `metadata-core`, `metadata-protocol`, `rest` and `cli`: exit 0.
- At `167dca9b79`: `runtime`'s `typecheck` first went red at `df2f5e39df`, because the new pin grew the shrink-only test-typecheck ledger by one TS18048. `167dca9b79` reads the response through optional chaining, after which the `runtime` `typecheck` exits 0 and `meta-migrate-stored.test.ts` passes 14/14. That commit changes one line of that one test file.
- **Gates, at the final head `167dca9b79`:** the lead list (59 commands) plus the 11 that re-derivation on the real diff added (the changeset family), 70 in all. Each exit code was captured before any pipe, and all 70 exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`, given the exit codes, reports 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero) and 0 UNRUN. Both `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` read real built output in this run (13 configs; 621 baselined, none new).
- **Lint, a proven narrowing:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 10 changed `.ts` files gives 10 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. An ignored file would have reported an ignore warning, so all 10 were linted. The repository's single `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its own comment says: no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch. The repository-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Other `PutOptions.actor` producers that pass a label (outside this claim; reported, not fixed)

A `git grep` across non-test `packages/**/*.ts` for an `actor:` set to a string literal, or for `actor ??` / `actor ||` falling back to one, found:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts`, `reconcilePermissionSetProjection` (called from `security-plugin.ts`), runs `saveMetaItem({ type: 'permission', …, actor: 'system' })`. That is #4556's retired sentinel, and it lands in `recorded_by`, `created_by` and `updated_by`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-environment-backfill.ts`, `backfillRowOnlyPositions`, runs `saveMetaItem({ …, actor: 'system' })`, with the same result.
- These are not `PutOptions.actor` and were not touched: `sys_metadata_audit.actor`'s `'system'` default (a `Field.text` column), the publish materializer's `actor: args.actor ?? 'system'`, and `contract-suite.ts`'s `'t'`/`'tester'` fixtures.

## Acceptance notes

- `FileSystemRepository` (`packages/metadata-fs`) defaults `fsActor` to `'fs'`, and that value reaches both `MetadataEvent.actor` (whose describe already says "never a sentinel string") and `MetadataItem.authoredBy`. `MetadataPlugin` attaches the repository without passing `fsActor`. This was already off-contract for events, and it now disagrees with the aligned `authoredBy` describe too. Reported for the seat. Not changed here.
- Rows that a migrate-stored pass rewrote before this release keep their label in `recorded_by` and `updated_by`. The `recorded-by-sentinel` journal plan rewrites only `'system'`, and its header claim that the column "has only ever held one sentinel" does not cover these labels. Whether a cleanup should follow is raised with the seat.
- `packages/metadata-core/test/types.test.ts` still uses `'cli'` as an `authoredBy` and `actor` fixture. The schema still accepts it. It is outside this claim's files, so it was left alone.
